name: iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF
blurb: TLT is an exchange-traded fund managed by BlackRock under the iShares brand that seeks to track the investment results of the ICE U.S. Treasury 20+ Year Bond Index. It holds U.S. government Treasury bonds with remaining maturities greater than 20 years, making it one of the longest-duration bond ETFs available. Because of its high duration, TLT is acutely sensitive to changes in long-term interest rates — price moves inversely with yields — and it is widely used by institutional and retail investors for interest-rate hedging, macro positioning, and fixed-income exposure. With tens of billions in assets under management, TLT is consistently one of the most actively traded ETFs in the U.S. market.
